title: nf-params-probe pipeline parameters
description: Probes how the Seqera Platform launch form resolves parameter defaults between nextflow.config and this schema (FD-7826).

user_supplied.title: User supplied
user_supplied.description: The one parameter a user is expected to fill in.

p7_user_input.description: Type anything here. Empty in nextflow.config, required here, no default.

probe_parameters.title: Probe parameters
probe_parameters.description: Each of these sits in a different relationship to nextflow.config. Leave them all untouched.

p2_config_null.description: null in nextflow.config, default here. Mirrors params.outdir in FD-7826.

p3_agree.description: Same value in nextflow.config and here. Control.

p4_disagree.description: 'CONFIG' in nextflow.config, 'SCHEMA' here. Shows which side the form takes.

p6_schema_only.description: Not declared in nextflow.config at all. Only here.
